Subject: POC sprint slate — next steps & proposed timeline

Hi Alex — thanks for the call this morning. Quick post-call recap and a proposed schedule to keep momentum:

Recap (2 mins):
- FinOpt's primary objective: validate inference latency at 95th pct < 300ms for 2k qps mixed workload and correctness on the payment reconciliation prompts.
- Success criteria we heard: latency SLOs, cost-per-inference estimate within target range, and a repeatable runbook to move to Dedicated if accepted.

Proposed kickoff & cadence (please confirm):
- Target kickoff: Tue 9/21 (we can shift if procurement needs a week).
- Duration: 4-week POC (3 weeks of run + 1 week readout + buffer).
- Weekly checkpoints: Tue 30-min sync (status, blockers, next steps). Final readout: Fri of week 4 (demo + performance deck).

Milestones & owners (high-level):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): procurement & access (FinOpt/procurement@finopt.com) — deliver NDA/POC paperwork by 9/17.
- Week 1: baseline tests + integration (Marissa) — data ingestion, sample prompt set, and test harness.
- Week 2: scale and stress runs (Aditya) — throughput characterization and batching configs.
- Week 3: tuning & quantization trials (Sergio + Eng) — price/perf trade-offs.
- Final readout: joint deck + recommendation (Sergio + Lauren).

Action items for you: please confirm kickoff date and share the initial sample dataset and a list of test accounts we can use (anonymized is fine). I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP-FinOpt-v1.xlsx) with the timeline and responsibilities.

Also linking our baseline SOC2 snapshot for procurement review (we can provide full evidence if you need it): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cFinOpt-POC

If 9/21 works we'll send calendar invites and the kickoff agenda.

Thanks,
Sergio

Thanks Sergio — appreciate the clear plan. A couple of notes/questions: 

1) Kickoff week: procurement is out next week, can we push kickoff to Tue 9/28 instead? That would give our legal/procurement team time to sign off on the POC terms.

2) Success criteria: could you explicitly call out the acceptance thresholds for the \"correctness\" metric? Our QA team needs pass/fail thresholds for the reconciliation prompt set (e.g., F1 > 0.92 or error rate < 8%).

3) Data: we'll share a 2k-row anonymized sample by EOD 9/16 (SLA permitting). For the test accounts, would sandbox credentials suffice or do you need production-like stubs?

Alex — great questions, and absolutely fine to shift kickoff to 9/28. Updated timeline below with more explicit metrics and weekly gating criteria so QA has clear acceptance definitions.

Updated timeline (kickoff Tue 9/28):
- Pre-kickoff (by 9/24): paperwork signed, access details, and anonymized sample dataset received.
- Week 1 (9/28–10/4): integration + baseline: collect baseline latency and correctness on the sample set. Acceptance gate: baseline run completed and results logged in shared Drive.
- Week 2 (10/5–10/11): throughput & batching: validate 95th pct latency < 300ms at target concurrency. Acceptance gate: 3 sustained runs at target qps within 10% variance.
- Week 3 (10/12–10/18): tuning & cost optimization: test quantized variants and caching; acceptance gate: recommended config that meets latency and cost target.
- Week 4 (10/19–10/22): readout prep + final demo (final readout Fri 10/22). Acceptance criteria for reconciliation prompts: F1 >= 0.92 AND end-to-end error rate < 8%.

Owners (detailed):
- Integration & data ingestion: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com)
- Throughput & scaling experiments: Aditya Rao (aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com)
- Performance analysis & recommendation + final deck: Sergio Alvarez (sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com)
- Operational runbook & handoff to Dedicated: Lauren Bishop (lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com)

Security/procurement evidence: attaching a SOC2 snapshot for procurement to review (SOC2-snapshot.pdf). If legal wants a controls mapping, Lauren can share the standard template (Lauren — can you flag the Doc here?).

Next actions (owner / due):
- FinOpt: confirm kickoff 9/28 and share anonymized sample (Alex) — due 9/24
- Redwood: send calendar invites + kickoff agenda (Lauren) — due 9/24
- Procurement: confirm POC terms (FinOpt procurement) — due 9/24

I attached the updated MAP and the SOC2 snapshot. If that works I'll circulate invites for Tue 9/28 9:00 AM PT.

—Sergio
